## Summary by coderabbit

• *New Features*  
   • Integrated Firebase Remote Config for real-time updates and A/B test group assignment.  
   • Added a manager for accessing and overriding remote config values.  
   • Splash screen now waits for Firebase initialization and applies remote config settings.  
   • Level packs and test variants can be set and parsed from remote config.
• *Improvements*  
   • Level packs can be set by name for easier dynamic content management.  
   • AnalyticsManager supports setting A/B test group propertie
<https://github.com/harmonygames-Games/match3d/pull/351|#351 Remote config>

## Walkthrough

This update integrates Firebase Remote Config into the Unity project. It adds new plugin binaries, Maven artifacts, and dependency manifests, and introduces a `FirebaseRemoteConfigManager` class for runtime access to remote config values. The splash screen now waits for remote config initialization and applies settings from the server. Several metadata and configuration files are updated or simplified, and Android/iOS plugin importers are configured for the new Remote Config components.
